overview: This batch focuses on finalizing the ultra-endgame state by implementing deterministic compression for the 5,500-tick simulation history and optimizing the Monte Carlo survival verification loop. The goal is to reduce memory footprint by 40% while maintaining bit-exact reproducibility for all 16,500 logged footsteps, ensuring zero-latency state restoration for the final ascension phase.

tasks.title: Implement Bit-Packed Deterministic State Serializer
tasks.architectural_spec: Use std::span for zero-copy input. Implement a static constexpr struct for header metadata. Use bitwise operations for packing tick counts (16-bit) and footstep IDs (12-bit). No dynamic allocation; use a fixed-size buffer of 4KB for the 5,500-tick summary. Ensure all fields are aligned to 4-byte boundaries for SIMD-friendly access.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Serialization of 5,500 ticks completes in < 1ms. 2. Deserialization yields bit-exact identical state to original. 3. Memory usage < 4KB for full history summary.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Instant load times for endgame saves; no perceptible lag during state restoration.

tasks.title: Optimize Monte Carlo Survival Verification Loop
tasks.architectural_spec: Refactor the verification loop to use a pre-allocated array of 16,500 uint32_t for footstep logs. Implement a branchless comparison using std::equal with execution policies. Remove all virtual function calls in the hot path. Use a static_assert to verify array sizes at compile time.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Verification of 16,500 footsteps completes in < 0.5ms. 2. Zero heap allocations during verification. 3. 100% match rate confirmed against BATCH-22 baseline.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster simulation ticks; smoother progression through the 5,500-tick endgame sequence.

tasks.title: Cache Final Ascension Narrative Nodes
tasks.architectural_spec: Create a constexpr array of 10 narrative strings for the final ascension phase. Use std::string_view for zero-copy access. Implement a linear search with early exit for node lookup. Ensure all strings are null-terminated and aligned.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Lookup time < 10ns per node. 2. No dynamic string allocations. 3. All 10 nodes accessible in order.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Seamless narrative flow during the final ascension; no stuttering in text display.
